description: This Dart source file defines a data structure for sample messages used in a chat-based micro-learning platform. It includes classes, sample message instances, suggestion prompts, and a utility function to generate stubbed responses based on user input.

classes.name: SampleMsg
classes.description: A simple data class representing a message in the sample chat, including text, sender indicator, and timestamp.

methods.name: pickStubbedAssistantReply
methods.description: Returns a stubbed assistant reply based on keywords detected in the user’s input message.
